q: The Engineering Plant Reserve is valued as per the formula:(R-N/L(R-S)} Where R= Present day price of the Plant, N is the Age of Plant, L= Life, S= Scrap Value(Estimated) and are fixed by:
options: B) Controller of Stores in consultation with FA&CAO
C) Chief Engineer with consultation of FA&CAO
D) Controller of Stores in consultation with Railway Board
